title: CNA Insider | Asia’s Stuck Generation
description: CNA Insider follows Taiwan's young graduates facing low wages, rising rents, long commutes, and decisions about working overseas.
longDescription: This CNA Insider documentary follows young graduates in Taiwan who struggle to save despite university degrees and steady work. Their choices include commuting long distances to avoid Taipei rents, taking several jobs, and seeking work overseas. The film connects these personal accounts with stagnant wages, rising housing costs, and questions about social housing.
heading: Producer | Director | Videographer

videos.title: Stuck With Low Pay, How Taiwan's Young Graduates Cope With High Costs | Asia's Stuck Generation.
videos.description: A multi-character documentary on Taiwanese graduates juggling long commutes, multiple jobs, and shrinking savings as low wages and high living costs undercut the promise of higher education.

title: CNA Insider | On The Red Dot
description: CNA Insider On The Red Dot documentary on comedian Suhaimi Yusof and his son navigating fame, family and a life-changing stroke.
longDescription: Actor-comedian Suhaimi Yusof and his youngest son Sufi spend three days together, talking about growing up with a famous father, expectations around marriage, and the impact of Suhaimi's stroke. This On The Red Dot portrait follows their disagreements and shared adventures as they find room for a more open father-son relationship.
heading: Producer | Director

videos.title: "There's A Lot Of Expectation": Growing Up As Comedian Suhaimi Yusof's Son | On The Red Dot
videos.description: An intimate father-son portrait in which comedian Suhaimi Yusof and his son Sufi confront fame, expectation, and the aftermath of a stroke, using heartfelt conversations to redefine how they understand each other.

portfolioCard.cardTitle: CNA Insider | On The Red Dot

title: 8World | 七天我可以 7 Days, I Can Do It
description: 8world follows chef Eric Teo from beginner archery lessons to a 36-arrow, 300-point challenge at 15 metres, all within seven days.
longDescription: Chef Eric Teo takes on a seven-day archery challenge in this two-part 8world programme. The first episode follows his lessons in stance, drawing the bow, scoring, and shooting at increasing distances, including a session with national-team archers. In the finale, he must shoot 36 arrows at 15 metres and reach a target of 300 points.
heading: Researcher | Writer

videos.title: 7 Days, I Can Do It | Celebrity Chef Eric Teo Learns Archery in 7 Days
videos.description: Chef Eric Teo learns stance, bow handling, and scoring, then practises at increasing distances. Coaching and a session with national-team archers test his early confidence as the seven-day challenge approaches.

videos.title: 7 Days, I Can Do It | 36 Arrows, 300 Points — Can Chef Eric Teo Do It?
videos.description: On day seven, Eric Teo faces six rounds of six arrows at 15 metres. He must reach 300 points out of a possible 360, bringing the week's training to a final test of accuracy and composure.

portfolioCard.cardTitle: 8World | 七天我可以 7 Days, I Can Do It

title: CNA | Dear Singapore
description: CNA's Dear Singapore profiles singer and producer Jasmine Sokko as she pursues music, navigates uncertainty, and rethinks success.
longDescription: Singaporean singer and music producer Jasmine Sokko reflects on choosing an unconventional career in a society that values stability and achievement. In this Dear Singapore film, she talks about her parents' financial concerns, the unpredictability of music, and finding self-worth beyond conventional measures of success.
heading: Field Producer | Local Fixer

videos.title: Singer Jasmine Sokko On Chasing Her Music Dreams: Every Dream Is Equally Worthy | Dear Singapore
videos.description: An intimate profile of Jasmine Sokko as she reflects on choosing music over stability, turning an unconventional career into a story about risk, identity, and what creative ambition costs in Singapore.

title: CNA Insider | Food, Wasted
description: CNA Insider documentary chapters on food waste, edible surplus, and whether urban farming can repair how cities value food.
longDescription: Two chapters from CNA Insider's Food, Wasted series examine how edible food is discarded and how city residents can reconnect with what they eat. The first follows food rescue efforts around unpopular cuts, imperfect produce, and near-expiry goods in Singapore, Hong Kong, and Taiwan. The third explores rooftop farms, community growing, and home gardens as ways to understand the effort behind food production.
heading: Field Producer

videos.title: Why Are We Throwing Away Perfectly Edible Food? | Food, Wasted 1/3
videos.description: Food rescue groups in Singapore, Hong Kong, and Taiwan find buyers for unpopular chicken cuts, imperfect produce, and near-expiry goods. The episode examines how consumer preferences and retail practices send edible food to waste.

videos.title: Can Urban Farming Fix Our Broken Relationship With Food? | Food, Wasted 3/3
videos.description: Rooftop farms in Hong Kong, urban growing in Singapore, and home gardeners show how raising food can change attitudes to waste. The episode follows the effort of growing and composting as city residents reconnect with their meals.

title: 8world | 看见主播
description: 8world anchor Wang Zheng explores midlife health in Singapore, from hawker food and mental health to blood pressure, cholesterol, and menopause.
longDescription: A four-part 8world series fronted by anchor Wang Zheng that turns midlife health concerns into practical, accessible stories. Across the episodes, the reporting looks at how busy Singaporeans in their 40s and 50s eat when they rely on hawker food, how to spot mental-health warning signs that get dismissed as everyday stress, why hypertension and high cholesterol often stay hidden until serious harm is done, and how menopause can reshape the body in ways many women only recognise once the changes have taken hold.
heading: Co-Director | Videographer

videos.title: 【看见主播 | 王征】40+这么吃，才不会发福？外食族必看
description: This episode focuses on the everyday diet traps facing midlife Singaporeans who depend on hawker meals and fast convenience.
It turns nutrition advice into practical food choices viewers can use without abandoning the routines of working life.

videos.title: 【看见主播 | 王征】40岁后最危险的不是压力
videos.description: An episode about the warning signs that stress, burnout, and mental-health struggles are no longer manageable with the usual 'just push through' mindset.

videos.title: 【看见主播 | 王征】40岁后你以为的健康，可能是错觉
videos.description: The reporting looks at how hidden risks such as high blood pressure and cholesterol stay invisible until a serious health scare forces action.

videos.title: 【看见主播 | 王征】女性40+，身体正在发生什么变化？
description: Wang Zheng guides viewers through a rethinking of menopause, explaining why women 45+ may notice waist gain and other body changes even when they are not eating more.
The episode frames menopause as a subtle but long-lasting transition, with doctors describing it less as decline than as a kind of 'phoenix rising'.

title: 8world | Presenter Insights
description: 8world Presenter Insights episodes on aging, retirement, and the identity shifts that surface when work, routine, and status fall away.
longDescription:
This 8world Presenter Insights series looks at aging through two different turning points in later life. One man resists retirement until a jarring work experience and personal loss make growing older feel urgent; another discovers that retirement itself can hollow out the identity and routine he once relied on.

Together, the episodes treat aging less as a fixed milestone than as an ongoing negotiation with work, purpose, family, and self-worth.
heading: Producer | Director | Writer

videos.title: Presenter Insights | At 64, he doesn't want to retire; an experience made him seriously face aging.
videos.description: At 64, Chen Poh Shin has never seriously thought about retirement. Having worked as a writer, hairstylist and in F&B management, and lived in several cities across China, he has always believed there is more of the world to experience. But a four-hour stint at a fast-food restaurant made him realise that ageing was becoming real, while the death of a friend who went unnoticed at home for a week forced him to confront his fears about growing old. Back in Singapore, he became a licensed tour guide.

videos.title: Presenter Insights | He Retired. Suddenly, No One Needed Him. "I Became a Nobody."
videos.description: After spending more than two decades working overseas, a former executive enters retirement and finds the structure, status, and busyness of work vanish almost overnight. The episode follows how he reconnects with family, brings his experience into community life, and returns to model trains as he asks who he is when a job no longer defines him.

title: 8World | Fun转时光
description: Five 8world heritage stories revisit Katong, Wayang Street, Fort Canning, the Satay Club, and Jubilee Theatre through Singaporeans' memories.
longDescription: This five-part Mandarin-language 8world series revisits Singapore through the memories of former residents, performers, and regular visitors. The stories move from Katong's pageant fashions and Wayang Street's theatres and hawkers to Fort Canning's National Theatre, Van Kleef Aquarium, and River Valley Swimming Pool. Other episodes recall the old Satay Club and the vanished Jubilee Theatre on North Bridge Road.
heading: Producer | Director | Videographer

videos.title: Fun转时光 | 彻夜卷发、鱼尾狮穿上身 80年代美姐难当! - Katong
videos.description: A nostalgic return to Katong through the lens of old-school glamour, pageant culture, and the beauty rituals that shaped a generation of Singaporean women.

videos.title: Fun转时光 | 旧时的余东璇街 是戏院美食街 - Wayang Street
videos.description: This episode retraces Wayang Street when it was packed with cinemas, crowds, and street food, mapping how entertainment once animated the neighborhood after dark.

videos.title: Fun转时光 | 皇家山六七十年代超好玩 探索昔日回忆的三宝! - Fort Canning
videos.description: Former visitors and a veteran performer recall Fort Canning's National Theatre, Van Kleef Aquarium, and River Valley Swimming Pool. Their memories revisit the performances and family outings of Singapore in the 1960s and 1970s.

videos.title: Fun转时光 | "五丛树脚"吃沙爹 老一辈独有的吃法 - Satay Club
videos.description: A food-memory episode about the old Satay Club, where smoky grills, shared tables, and improvised rituals turned a meal into a distinctly Singaporean night out.

videos.title: Fun转时光 | 桥北路消失的光影记忆：光华大戏院 - Jubilee Theatre
videos.description: The series closes at Jubilee Theatre, recovering the vanished movie-going culture of North Bridge Road and the emotional pull these lost venues still hold.

title: CNA Insider | SCDF 995 Calls
description: CNA Insider follows Singapore's SCDF 995 call takers and ambulance crews, then hears officers reflect on abuse, obstacles, and emotional cases.
longDescription: Two CNA Insider films examine Singapore's emergency medical services. One follows a 995 call through triage, ambulance dispatch, paramedic response, and the resuscitation room at Singapore General Hospital, showing how non-emergency calls compete for resources. The companion film hears SCDF officers reflect on abusive callers, drivers blocking ambulances, difficult access, and cases that stay with them.
heading: Co-Producer | Director | Videographer

videos.title: SCDF Officers React To Abusive Calls, Emotional Cases And Ambulance-Blocking Drivers
videos.description: Told through EMS officers' reflections, this companion piece shows how abuse, blocked ambulances, and emotional cases complicate emergency work long after the sirens fade.

videos.title: On Call With Singapore's SCDF Emergency Medical Services: When Minutes Can Mean Life Or Death
videos.description: The film follows 995 call takers, ambulance dispatchers, and paramedics through urgent cases and hospital handovers. It also examines how false alarms and non-emergency calls divert resources from patients who need immediate help.

title: CNA Insider | Our Blind Kitchen
description: CNA Insider's Our Blind Kitchen follows visually impaired chefs building Kunyah Cafe in Singapore, through kitchen adaptations and staffing setbacks.
longDescription: Our Blind Kitchen follows social entrepreneur Aaron Yeoh and visually impaired cooks as they prepare to open Kunyah Cafe at Singapore Management University. Across three episodes, the team adapts the kitchen, tests its food, and confronts differences in working styles. A chef's departure leads to a new hire with cerebral palsy just days before opening, testing both the business and its ambition to create meaningful jobs for people with disabilities.
heading: Researcher | Producer | Director | Videographer

videos.title: Episode 1: We're Chefs, We're Partly Blind & We're Opening A Cafe
videos.description: Aaron Yeoh brings together visually impaired cooks to open Kunyah Cafe at Singapore Management University. Kitchen adaptations, recipe testing, and an early tasting session reveal the practical demands of building an inclusive food business.

videos.title: Episode 2: A Chef Makes A Shock Exit, But Why?
videos.description: The Kunyah Cafe team hosts dinners for its supporters, but different working styles lead to a chef's departure three weeks before opening. Founder Aaron Yeoh faces the challenge of balancing the business with the team's needs.

videos.title: Episode 3: I Hire A Chef With Cerebral Palsy, 3 Days Before Opening
videos.description: A cook with cerebral palsy joins Kunyah Cafe shortly before launch. The team works through training, customer orders, and opening-day setbacks as it tests whether the cafe can create sustainable jobs for people with disabilities.

title: 星星之火：新聞人的一生志業
description: A Taiwanese documentary on the news industry’s digital disruption, commercial pressures, and enduring public-interest values.
longDescription: This documentary brings together Taiwanese news professionals across generations to consider how journalism can adapt as digital platforms reshape audience attention and media revenue. Their reflections on professional purpose, public trust, and industry change frame the future of news as a shared civic question.
heading: Producer

videos.title: 星星之火：新聞人的一生志業
videos.description: Taiwanese news professionals reflect on digital disruption, commercial pressure, public trust, and the civic purpose of journalism.

portfolioCard.cardTitle: 星星之火：新聞人的一生志業

title: CNA Insider | Lunch With Us
description: Four CNA Insider food stories explore Tekka Centre, Banqiao's cheap eats, retro Taipei bentos, and a karaoke cabbie's favourite lunch stop.
longDescription: Four Lunch With Us stories explore everyday meals in Singapore and Taiwan with local guides. In Tekka Centre, chef Rathakrishnan visits South Asian stalls and Delhi Lahori's Indian-Pakistani set meals. The Taiwan episodes follow food entrepreneur Matt Chen through Banqiao in New Taipei City, writers to an old-school pork-chop bento restaurant in Taipei, and a karaoke cabbie to the Drivers' Club in Songshan.
heading: Producer | Director | Videographer

videos.title: Budget 'Fast-Food' Hopping In Taiwan: From Vegetarian to Pork Cheap Eats | Taipei
videos.description: Food entrepreneur Matt Chen explores affordable meals in Banqiao, New Taipei City, from vegetarian dishes and oyster vermicelli to braised pork rice and handmade pork-ball soup. The story meets vendors keeping everyday lunches within reach.

videos.title: S$6 Michelin Meals at Indian-Pakistani Hawker Stall in Tekka | Singapore
videos.description: Chef Rathakrishnan explores South Asian cooking at Tekka Centre in Singapore's Little India. At Delhi Lahori, he meets the owner behind Indian-Pakistani set meals and watches naan baked in a charcoal tandoor.

videos.title: Taiwan-style Bento Meals With Old-School Touch & Retro Vibe | Taipei
videos.description: Writers Hsieh Yi An and Chu Yu Hsun visit Dong Yi Pork Chop in Taipei's Zhongzheng District. The retro restaurant and its co-founder open a conversation about Taiwanese bento meals, food history, and the venue's former dance-hall life.

videos.title: Taiwan's Karaoke Cabbie Takes Us To Comfort Food 'Club' | Taipei
videos.description: Karaoke cabbie Tu Ching-liang takes viewers to the Drivers' Club in Taipei's Songshan District. The long-running lunch stop serves pork rice, soup, and familiar dishes to cab drivers and a growing mix of visitors.

title: 8world | Frontline
description: 8world Frontline reports explore Singapore's fertility decisions, male caregivers, and the hidden trade behind illicit massage parlours.
longDescription: Three episodes from 8world's Frontline current-affairs programme examine different pressures in Singapore. One brings together people with contrasting experiences of parenthood, childlessness, and fertility treatment. Another follows men caring for parents and children while balancing work and exhaustion. The third investigates how borrowed licences and concealed operators enable illicit massage businesses, with perspectives from the massage industry, traditional Chinese medicine, and a former secret-society figure.
heading: Field Producer

videos.title: Frontline | Fertility rate falls to 0.87 Are Singaporeans going extinct?!
videos.description: A reported look at why Singaporeans hesitate to start families, following the financial, emotional, and social pressures behind the country's record-low fertility rate.

videos.title: Frontline | Who Says Caring for Parents Is Only for Women?
description: This companion story follows male caregivers balancing work, fatigue, and filial duty as they care for ageing parents and sick relatives.
It broadens the series from fertility decisions to the unequal care burdens shaping family life in Singapore.

videos.title: 前线追踪 | 假按摩，真色情？ 前私会党候选帮主揭乱象内幕
description: An investigative 前线追踪 report on how nominee licence holders, borrowed TCM credentials, and 'front-shop, back-room' setups let some massage parlours mask an illegal vice trade in Singapore.
Massage-chain owner Dickson Mah, TCM practitioner Heng Buck Teck, and former secret-society figure Wong Kee Soon expose the profit-driven ecosystem behind the racket as Singapore tightens its rules.

title: 8world | 前线追踪
description: 8world Frontline follows a young Singaporean quitting compulsive social-media use, and examines school phone rules and families' responses.
longDescription: This Frontline report follows a 20-year-old who deletes his social-media apps after four years of compulsive scrolling that affected his studies and motivation. It also visits Singapore schools with tighter phone rules and hears from students, parents, and a counsellor about whether school restrictions carry through to life at home.
heading: Videographer

videos.title: 前线追踪 | 深陷社媒四年 他删光所有应用
description: This Frontline report follows a 20-year-old who deletes every social-media app after four years of compulsive use, showing how endless scrolling and fear of missing out can take over daily life.

Part of 8world's long-running current-affairs series 前线追踪, the episode widens the story into Singapore's tighter school phone rules and the larger question of whether restrictions alone can change behavior.

title: Into The Gym | Johnson Health Tech Web Series
description: Johnson Health Tech's Taiwan web series pairs Kunda with athletes and creators for badminton, basketball, boxing, and fitness challenges.
longDescription: Host Kunda joins athletes, entertainers, and creators in this Johnson Health Tech branded web series from Taiwan. Eight guest episodes combine sports challenges and workouts using the Johnson@Mirror fitness system, with appearances by badminton champion Tai Tzu-ying, Joeman, KU, and other guests. A ninth video brings together highlights from the season.
heading: Executive Producer

videos.title: 坤達對決世界球后戴資穎，看小戴挑戰100秒20宮格羽球準度挑戰！【 EP1 】
videos.description: The season opener pairs host Kunda with badminton champion Tai Tzu-ying, turning a celebrity workout into a brisk challenge story built on precision, competitive tension, and world-class training habits.

videos.title: 坤達揪Joeman健身，意外發現防綠帽神器【EP2】
videos.description: A studio visit with Joeman mixes creator banter and fast-burn coaching, showing how the series can fold influencer culture and practical fitness tips into one brand-friendly format.

videos.title: 坤達揪 法國人酷KU健身，進階版炸裂胸肌訓練。KU：竟然有這種方法？！【EP3】feat.酷的夢
videos.description: This episode teams Kunda with French creator KU for an advanced chest workout, then widens into food and lifestyle beats that keep the branded fitness format playful rather than repetitive.

videos.title: 袁艾菲為金鐘獻上深V裸背，坤達以美背三式相助艾菲【EP4】
videos.description: A home-visit episode with Yuan Ai-fei blends cooking, comedy, and targeted back training, framing the workout around a real appearance goal instead of generic exercise advice.

videos.title: 每朝女神張景嵐性感報到！獨家小蠻腰健身菜單，坤達:「我們可以偷偷的⋯」【EP5】
videos.description: With Zhang Ching-lan, the series leans into playful chemistry, combat-style cardio, and a defined ab routine, weaving product features into the episode without breaking the entertainment flow.

videos.title: 全壘打大賽！坤達蔡哥拚盡尊嚴，努力揮擊。陳晨威：讓你們拿鋁棒【EP6】
videos.description: Shot at a pro ballpark, this baseball-themed episode scales the format up with stadium access, sports-star competition, and locker-room variety energy while keeping the workout challenge at its core.

videos.title: 雙生鬥士 Yin&Yei 籃壇帥度破表，籃球一哥 坤達表情逐漸母湯！【EP7】
videos.description: Twin basketball players Yin and Yei bring a strong guest hook to an episode that balances on-court games, core training, and music-driven class moments that make digital fitness feel social and fun.

videos.title: UFC八角鐵籠的終極格鬥賽？ 夢多直誇天才！坤達：我有看第一神拳？！【EP8】
videos.description: An octagon-style challenge with Dreamondo pushes the series into fight-sports spectacle, using humor and host vulnerability to make a punishing workout feel human, accessible, and highly watchable.

videos.title: 坤達使出回憶殺！Johnson@mirror眾星開箱體驗！【EP9】坤達一打十超精彩健身魔鏡開箱合集
videos.description: The season recap repackages standout guests, mirror functions, and challenge highlights into a campaign-friendly supercut that extends the series' value well beyond its weekly release.

title: CNA Insider | UNIQLO
description: CNA Insider follows shoppers with visual, mobility, and sensory needs as they test UNIQLO's quiet-hour assisted shopping in Singapore.
longDescription: This CNA Insider feature follows shoppers testing UNIQLO's 2023 Access pilot at its Ang Mo Kio outlet in Singapore. Their experiences show how quiet shopping hours, personal assistance, wider walkways, and an accessible fitting room can make a difference for people with visual impairments, wheelchair users, and people with autism or sensory sensitivities.
heading: Co-Producer | Videographer

videos.title: We Try UNIQLO’s Private Shopping Services, For Customers With Special Needs
videos.description: Shoppers with different access needs test UNIQLO's quiet-hour assisted shopping at its Ang Mo Kio outlet. Their visits show where personal assistance, reduced noise, wider spaces, and fitting-room aids help, and where staff training matters.

title: CNA Insider | Fibromyalgia
description: Four people share life with fibromyalgia in this CNA Insider film, from delayed diagnoses and chronic pain to stigma and finding support.
longDescription: Four people living with fibromyalgia describe chronic pain, fatigue, and the uncertainty of seeking a diagnosis when routine tests offer few answers. This CNA Insider documentary follows their experiences of being disbelieved, managing everyday life, and finding support from family, partners, and other people with the condition.
heading: Co-Producer | Videographer

videos.title: Living With Chronic Pain That Even Doctors Don’t Believe - This Is Fibromyalgia
videos.description: Through first-person accounts from fibromyalgia patients, the documentary traces the pain of being disbelieved, misdiagnosed, and forced to explain an invisible illness that medicine still struggles to define.

portfolioCard.cardTitle: Living With Chronic Pain That Even Doctors Don’t Believe - This Is Fibromyalgia

title: CNA Insider | MOM
description: CNA Insider profiles Thai robotics engineer Krittin Kawkeeree at Singapore start-up dConstruct, building navigation systems and mentoring interns.
longDescription: Thai-born robotics engineer Krittin Kawkeeree builds autonomous navigation systems at Singapore start-up dConstruct. This CNA Insider profile looks at how his work supports the company's robots and 3D mapping tools, and follows his role in training local interns to become engineers. The film was produced in partnership with Singapore's Ministry of Manpower.
heading: Producer | Director | Videographer

videos.title: I Build Robots For A Living. Here's Why I Chose To Work In Singapore & How I'm Giving Back
videos.description: This profile follows Thai robotics engineer Krittin Kawkeeree as he builds autonomous systems and mentors local talent, linking one career story to bigger questions of belonging, opportunity, and contribution in Singapore.

title: CNA Insider | TV Spin Offs
description: CNA Insider follows Lee Kwong Luen, a Singapore father rebuilding his identity after 14 years caring for a son with autism and haemophilia B.
longDescription: Lee Kwong Luen spent 14 years as a stay-at-home father caring for his son, who has autism and haemophilia B. In this CNA Insider portrait, he talks about criticism of his caregiving role, isolation, and depression. The film also follows how tai chi helps him begin to reclaim time and an identity of his own.
heading: Producer | Director | Videographer | Video Editor

videos.title: I Spent 14 Years As A Stay-At-Home Dad For My Son. Here's Why It's Time To Reclaim My Life
videos.description: A candid portrait of a father rebuilding life after 14 years of caregiving, using one family's story to explore masculinity, sacrifice, isolation, and the slow work of reclaiming selfhood.

title: CNA Insider | Gen Z Lion Dancers
description: CNA Insider follows Nicolas Goh's young Singapore lion-dance troupe, recruited through TikTok, as they train, handle conflicts, and compete.
longDescription: Second-generation lion dancer Nicolas Goh leads Singapore's Namyang Troupe Lion Dance Centre and recruits a young team through TikTok. This CNA Insider film follows the work behind their online performances as members train for competition, navigate school and national-service commitments, and challenge stereotypes about who can take part in lion dancing.
heading: Co-Producer | Director | Videographer

videos.title: Gen Z Lion Dancers Of TikTok Fame: Is Passion Enough?
videos.description: Nicolas Goh recruits young lion dancers through TikTok and prepares his Namyang troupe for competition. The film follows training, attendance problems, and the effort of bringing together members from different backgrounds.

portfolioCard.cardTitle: CNA Insider | Gen Z Lion Dancers

title: CNA Insider | Scam Series
description: Two CNA Insider accounts show how romance and fake cryptocurrency investments drew scam victims in, and how the losses affected their lives.
longDescription: Two first-person accounts reconstruct scams that combined online relationships with fake cryptocurrency investments. Nana describes how a TikTok conversation led to losses and conflict within her family. Samantha, a divorcee from Malaysia, recalls an Instagram contact who used romantic promises and secrecy to gain her trust. The films follow the warning signs they recognised afterwards and the personal cost of the fraud.
heading: Producer | Director | Videographer

videos.title: I Fell For An Investment Scam: Here's How They Got Me
videos.description: Nana describes how a conversation about her dog on TikTok developed into trust in a stranger and a fake investment scheme. Her account traces the loss of more than S$64,000 and the strain it placed on her family.

videos.title: I Fell For A Love Scam: How They Made It Seem So Real
videos.description: Samantha, a divorcee from Malaysia, recalls an Instagram relationship built on daily messages and promises of a shared future. The supposed partner steered her towards a fake cryptocurrency platform while asking her to keep the relationship secret.

title: CNA Insider | Healthcare Heroes
description: CNA Insider’s Healthcare Heroes follows Khoo Teck Puat Hospital’s home-visit programme supporting people with alcohol misuse to reduce repeat A&E visits.
longDescription: Khoo Teck Puat Hospital's Alcohol-Related Frequent Attenders programme supports patients who repeatedly visit A&E with alcohol-related problems. This Healthcare Heroes film follows a community nurse and social worker on home visits, where they build trust, address practical difficulties, and help patients set realistic goals or seek further support.
heading: Producer | Director | Videographer

videos.title: The Hospital That Helps Alcoholics Stay Out Of The A&E | Healthcare Heroes
videos.description: A community nurse and social worker support people with alcohol-misuse issues at home, helping to prevent repeat emergency-department visits through trust and practical care.

title: CNA Insider | Joshimath
description: CNA Insider examines why India's Himalayan town of Joshimath is sinking, linking unstable ground, drainage, construction, and climate pressure.
longDescription: After buildings collapsed and residents were displaced in early 2023, this report traces why Joshimath’s terrain is so vulnerable. It links landslide debris, poorly planned drainage, rapid construction, and climate pressure to a warning for mountain towns across the Himalayas.
heading: Video Editor

videos.title: Why Is Joshimath, India’s Himalayan Holy Town, Sinking?
videos.description: A report on why unstable terrain, development, and climate pressure have put Joshimath’s residents and buildings at growing risk.

title: CNA Insider | Malware Scam
description: CNA Insider explains how social-media adverts can lead to phone malware and bank-account theft, with warning signs and a victim's account.
longDescription: Through a malware-scam case, this explainer shows how a seemingly legitimate social-media advert can lead to remote control of a victim’s phone. It identifies warning signs of infection and the urgent steps to take before further loss.
heading: Video Editor

videos.title: A Scammer Hijacked My Phone: How To Tell If You’ve Got Malware And What To Do
videos.description: An explainer on how malicious apps let scammers remotely control phones, the warning signs to look for, and what to do urgently.

title: Mark Your Calendar | 历历在目 | Infotainment
description: Infotainment series exploring how Singapore celebrates Halloween, Deepavali, Winter Solstice, and Christmas.
longDescription: This four-episode infotainment series uses major festivals as a way into Singapore's multicultural calendar. The selected episodes follow hosts into Halloween parades and trick-or-treat parties, Deepavali traditions and festival markets, Winter Solstice food rituals, and Christmas activities from logcake making to church services.
heading: Producer | Director

videos.title: EP10 萬聖節Halloween | Host: 龐蕾馨(Kate Pang )、謝穎澤(Estovan)
